statement: --t1: T1 full head input (not bias corrected), requiring an absolute path.
quote:
--t1 <t1_path> T1 full head input (not bias corrected). Requires an
ABSOLUTE Path!

statement: Optional T2 full-head input must be externally biasfield corrected when --no_biasfield is used.
quote:
*Optional* T2 full head input (must be externally biasfield
corrected when called with --no_biasfield). Requires an
ABSOLUTE Path!

statement: An optional binary lesion mask must be in the same space as the T1 input.
quote: Path to a binary lesion mask in the same space as the T1 input.

statement: For --surf_only, the segmentation created by FastSurferVINN must already exist.
quote: --surf_only: Only run the surface pipeline. The segmentation created by FastSurferVINN must already exist in this case.

statement: A segmentation without --tal_reg does not need a FreeSurfer licence.
quote:
A
segmentation without --tal_reg does not need one.

statement: Docker runs of the surface module require --fs_license pointing to a FreeSurfer licence file.
quote:
Required for Docker when running surface module:

--fs_license: Path to FreeSurfer license key file

statement: Input conformation specifications are checked automatically; non-compliant images are conformed.
quote: These specifications are checked in the run_prediction.py script and the image is automatically conformed if it does not comply.

statement: Keeping native image geometry is incompatible with the surface pipeline.
quote:
Output all images and segmentations in the native
--keepgeom image space with its image geometry (voxel size,
dimensions, orientation). This setting is not
compatible with the surface pipeline

statement: A GPU makes segmentation much faster.
quote: A GPU makes the segmentation much faster.

statement: --viewagg_device auto checks whether there is enough memory to run view aggregation on the GPU.
quote: By default, the program checks if you have enough memory to run the view aggregation on the GPU.

statement: Unless --ignore_fs_version is set, the program checks the FreeSurfer version and terminates if the supported version is not sourced.
quote:
--ignore_fs_version Switch on to avoid check for FreeSurfer version.
Program will terminate if the supported version
(see recon-surf.sh) is not sourced.

statement: --qc_snap creates quality control images to simplify the QC process.
quote: --qc_snap Create quality control images in $SUBJECTS_DIR/$sid/qc_snapshots

statement: For images with tumors or other large lesions, review LIT-modified outputs before downstream use.
quote: review LIT-modified outputs before downstream use.

statement: Without --no_cereb, CerebNet runs automatically whenever the segmentation module runs.
quote: Unless switched off by the --no_cereb argument, this module is automatically run whenever the segmentation module is run.

statement: Without --no_hypothal, HypVINN runs automatically whenever the segmentation module runs.
quote: Unless switched off by the --no_hypothal argument, this module is automatically run whenever the segmentation module is run.

statement: With --no_biasfield, HypVINN still runs but expects biasfields to be corrected externally.
quote: HypVINN does run but expects that biasfields are corrected externally.

statement: --no_surfreg skips surface registration, but sphere.reg is needed for cross-subject statistical analysis of thickness maps.
quote: sphere.reg will be needed for any cross-subject statistical analysis of thickness maps

statement: Renaming an output file can break a later step, since later modules and follow-up tools look for the default names.
quote:
Later modules
and follow-up tools look for the default names, so renaming an output can
break a later step.

statement: The input data file has each frame as a separate input.
quote: Path to input file with each frame being a separate input.

statement: Global design matrix specified with a FreeSurfer Group Descriptor File (FSGDF).
quote: Specify the global design matrix with a FreeSurfer Group Descriptor File (FSGDF).

statement: One or more contrast matrix files in ASCII text.
quote: Specify one or more contrasts to test. The contrast.mat file is an ASCII text file with the contrast matrix in it

statement: Surface-based smoothing requires --surf; otherwise the input is treated as a volume.
quote: If the data are surface-based, then you must specify --surf, otherwise mri_glmfit assumes that the input is a volume

statement: Data must be assembled by resampling each subject's data into a common space and concatenating subjects into a single file.
quote:
Resampling each subject's data into a common space.

Concatenating all the subjects' into a single file.

statement: The same FSGD used with mris_preproc must be used, maintaining subject order.
quote: Same FSGD used as with mris_preproc. Maintains subject order!

statement: DODS is specified in the tutorial example and is the default.
quote: DODS is specified (it is the default).

statement: If data have not been cached, the same operations can be performed manually.
quote: In the case that you have not cached the data, you can perform the same operations manually using the two commands below.

statement: The completed GLM has its output subdirectory under the glm directory.
quote: When this command is finished the glm directory will contain a sub-directory called lh.gender_age.glmdir.

statement: There is a subdirectory for each specified contrast, named after the contrast matrix file without the .mtx extension.
quote: There will be a subdirectory for each contrast that you specify. The name of the directory will be that of the contrast matrix file (without the .mtx extension).

statement: mri_info can be run on the assembled data to find its dimensions.
quote: Run mri_info on lh.gender_age.thickness.10.mgh to find its dimensions:

statement: Temporary directories or log files starting with tmp may appear and can be ignored.
quote: You may also see some temporary directories (with names starting with tmp) or log files, which you can ignore.

statement: You cannot specify both --X and --osgm, and a contrast cannot be specified with --osgm.
quote: You cannot specify both --X and --osgm. A contrast cannot be specified either.

statement: Do not use --prune with --sim; instead run the non-sim analysis with --prune and pass the created mask to the simulation.
quote: Do not use with --sim. Rather, run the non-sim analysis with --prune, then pass the created mask when running simulation.

Option is valid for the NMT v2 only--in

CHARM Level 1 is volume "[0]" and Level 6 is volume
